subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which remaining EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError recovery path should own this issue: land/adopt the mergeable silent-message-loss fix, repair the conflicting no-op rewrite/user-stop PRs, or split the typing and lock cleanup leftovers into narrower tracked issues?
rationale: Current main has partial retained-lock cleanup, but the issue spans message loss, typing cleanup, and false-positive fence behavior with several overlapping open PRs, so another autonomous fix would compete with maintainer sequencing.

options.title: Sequence Existing PRs
options.body: Use the open related PRs as the fix path, starting with the mergeable silent-message-loss PR and then deciding whether the conflicting narrower PRs still need repair.

options.title: Split Remaining Symptoms
options.body: Keep this issue open but split typing cleanup, no-op fence rewrite, and fallback delivery persistence into separate canonical issues before implementation.

options.title: Queue One New Repair
options.body: Allow a new ClawSweeper fix PR to replace the overlapping branches, accepting the risk of duplicating existing contributor work.

recommendation.title: Sequence Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Use the open related PRs as the fix path, starting with the mergeable silent-message-loss PR and then deciding whether the conflicting narrower PRs still need repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged retained-lock partial fix for this issue and are the clearest routing candidate for the remaining sequencing choice.
